title: Protocol for mouse adult neural stem cell isolation and culture
protocol: Euthanize one adult (age 6–24 weeks) C57BL/6 mouse.
Sterilize the dissection area, surgery tools, and the head of the euthanized mouse with 70% ethanol.
Surgically remove the brain and transfer it to a 50-mL tube with ice cold dissection buffer.
Slice the brain into 1.0 mm coronal sections using a Mouse Brain Slicer Matrix for the SVZ and hippocampal DG regions.
Collect the slices containing the hippocampus or the SVZ into a 10 cm petri dish filled with ice cold dissection buffer.
Isolate the dentate gyrus or SVZ from each relevant slice under a microscope.
Dissect the DG or SVZ using a scalpel or needle while stabilizing the slice with angled forceps.
Transfer the dissected tissue to the cap of a 15-mL tube and mince it with fine scissors.
Attach the cap to its 15-mL tube containing 10 mL ice cold dissection buffer, rotate once to suspend tissue chunks, and keep on ice.
After finishing dissection of all relevant brain sections, spin down the tissue at 200 g for 1 minute at 18°C–25°C.
Aspirate the dissection buffer from the tube containing tissue chunks.
Add 1 mL of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA to the 15-mL tube with tissue chunks.
Incubate at 37°C with slow mixing such as gentle rotation or light shaking in a water bath.
Confirm adequate digestion by pipetting slowly up and down a few times with a p1000 pipet.
Continue digestion at 37°C for 5-15 min if inadequate, but do not exceed 30 min of digestion.
Add 1 mL of Trypsin inhibitor solution to inhibit further digestion.
Incubate the mixture for 20 min at 37°C with slow mixing.
Triturate the tissue by pipetting up and down 10–20 times using a p1000, then using a p200 until only few tissue clumps are visible.
Add 8 mL of wash media and pellet the triturated cells at 200 g for 5 min at 18°C–25°C.
Wash the cells two times by resuspending in 10 mL wash media, then spinning at 200 g for 5 min.
Wash the cells once in 6 mL growth media and spin down at 200 g for 5 min.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL of growth media and plate them into a single well of a low-adherent 24-well culture plate.
Incubate the cells in a 5% CO2 incubator at 37°C for 48 hours.
Exchange half of the media with fresh growth media after 48 h by slowly aspirating media from a single periphery point.
Replace half of the media with fresh growth media every second day.
After 1–2 weeks, neurospheres should form.
Proceed to the next step for passage of aNSCs when neurospheres are detected.
Avoid generating excess air bubbles during the triturating and wash steps as this can affect cell viability.
In the last wash step, pass the cells through a 100 μm cell strainer to remove undigested tissue (optional).
Some method optimization might be required for mice strains other than C57BL/6.
Passage isolated aNSCs in low adherence 6 well plates or 35 mm petri dishes.
Collect neurospheres of size 50–100 μm using a p1000 into a 15-mL tube.
Spin down the collected neurospheres at 200 g for 5 min at 18°C–25°C.
Aspirate the media and add 1 mL of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA per well/dish.
Incubate at 37°C with slow mixing for 1–2 minutes.
Add equal volume of trypsin inhibitor to the neurospheres.
Triturate into single cells using a p1000 and then a p200.
Add equal volume of growth media to the single-cell suspension.
Spin down the suspension at 200 g for 5 min.
Aspirate and suspend the cells in fresh growth media.
Count cell number and viability.
Seed cells at 1×10ˆ5 cells/mL into low adherent 6-well plates or 35 mm petri dishes.
Incubate seeded neurospheres in a 5% CO2, 37°C incubator.
Passage the neurospheres every 2–4 days.
Ensure neurospheres are around 50–100 μm in diameter when passaging.
Coat flask/wells with 20 μg/mL Poly-L-ornithine in PBS overnight at 37°C for differentiation of cells two days before seeding.
Wash flask/wells 3 times for 1 minute each with PBS the next day after coating with Poly-L-ornithine.
Coat flask/wells with 5 mg/mL Laminin in PBS overnight at 37°C after washing.
Wash flask/wells 3 times for 1 minute each with PBS on the day of cell seeding.
Wait to aspirate PBS just before adding media/cells during the last wash.
Seed aNSCs in cell flasks or wells at approximately 40000 cells per cm².
Keep the seeded cells in a 5% CO2 incubator at 37°C.
Exchange half of the media with freshly prepared differentiation media the next day.
Repeat media exchange daily for neuron/astrocyte differentiation and every other day for OPC medium over 5 days.
After 5 days, analyze differentiated cells using quantitative methods like qPCR, immunofluorescence-based assays, or flow cytometry.
Seed aNSCs in Poly-L-ornithine/Laminin-coated cell culture slides.
Incubate the seeded cells for 12–16 hours in a 5% CO2 incubator at 37°C.
Aspirate medium and wash twice with ice-cold PBS, each for 1 minute.
Add ice-cold 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS pH 7.4 and incubate for 30 minutes at 18°C–25°C.
Wash fixed cells three times with PBS, each for 5 minutes.
Incubate fixed cells with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 15 minutes at 18°C–25°C.
Follow incubation with 3% bovine serum albumin (BSA), 0.01% Triton X-100, and PBS for 30 minutes.
Incubate fixed cells with anti-nestin antibodies at a dilution of 1:400.
Incubate fixed cells with anti-Sox2 antibodies at a dilution of 1:400.
Wash cells three times for five minutes each in PBS.
Incubate fixed cells with secondary fluorescence-conjugated antibody at a dilution of 1:800.
Wash cells once for five minutes in PBS.
Incubate cells with DAPI at a dilution of 1:2000 for five minutes.
Wash cells twice for five minutes each in PBS.
Mount cell slides with coverslip.
Seed aNSCs on cell culture slides.
Differentiate seeded aNSCs as detailed in specified protocol.
Aspirate media after 5 days of differentiation.
Wash cells twice with ice-cold PBS for 1 minute each.
Incubate cells with ice-cold 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS pH 7.4 for 30 minutes at 18°C–25°C.
Wash cells three times with PBS, 5 minutes each.
Incubate fixed cells with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 15 minutes at 18°C–25°C.
Incubate fixed cells with blocking solution (3% BSA, 0.01% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 30 minutes.

Stain fixed cells with neural differentiation markers: anti-Map2 (neuronal marker), anti-GFAP (astrocytic marker), and Olig2 (oligodendrocyte progenitor cell marker) at appropriate dilutions, for 2 hours at 18°C–25°C or overnight at 4°C.
Wash cells three times with PBS, 5 minutes each.
Incubate fixed cells with secondary fluorescence-conjugated antibodies in blocking solution for 1 hour at 18°C–25°C in the dark.
Wash cells once with PBS for 5 minutes.
Stain cells with DAPI (1:2000) for 5 minutes.
Wash cells twice with PBS, 5 minutes each.
Mount cell slides with coverslip.
